Omar Khan (Helio): Hey CS—onboarding snag. Our Go client starts failing after ~30s with 403 then a flood of 429s. Error sequence in logs: 'token_expired' then 'quota_exceeded: per_key'. Demo in 36h, blocked.
Priya Khatri: Thanks Omar. Quick check: which Go SDK version and are you hitting our API directly or through your gateway?
Omar Khan (Helio): go-sdk v0.9.1, going through our infra-gateway. We mint very short-lived tokens TTL=30s and rotate at ~5s before expiry. We kept old token for 15s to avoid mid-stream breakage.
Ravi Desai: Keeping the old token for 15s with TTL 30s sounds risky if your gateway multiplexes. Two different bearer tokens can hit auth at nearly the same time and count double against per-key quotas.
Omar Khan (Helio): Repro log: 
HTTP/1.1 200 OK (t=0)
...
# t=28s swap occurs
HTTP/1.1 403 {"error":"token_expired"}
HTTP/1.1 429 {"error":"quota_exceeded","quota":"per_key"} (many retries follow)
Priya Khatri: Two actions to try: 1) for a quick smoke, reduce old-token retention to <=2s and add jittered exponential backoff for retries (start 100ms, mult 2, max 1s). 2) we'll enable a short TEMP_PERKEY_RELAX for Helio while you validate.
Ravi Desai: Also check if your gateway does connection pooling with header replay; if so, you should pin the token to the connection or avoid mid-stream rotation.
Omar Khan (Helio): Concern: TTL 30s chosen for security reasons. If we lengthen TTL we'll increase attack surface. Any alternatives?
Priya Khatri: You can keep short TTL but reduce overlap window when swapping. Another pattern: use a separate streaming token with slightly longer TTL for streams and short TTL for new auth, or rotate only on reconnects for streaming RPCs.
Ravi Desai: We can also add server-side mitigation: temporarily relax per-key counting window so duplicate auth checks during rotation don't count one-for-one. We'll open a ticket and enable relax for 2 hours.
CS Bot: Ticket created CS-11021  labels: onboarding, auth, rate-quota. TEMP_PERKEY_RELAX enabled until 3412349200.
Omar Khan (Helio): I'll try oldKeep=2s and backoff now, report in 10m. Thanks.
Priya Khatri: If that passes, we'll update the onboarding guide with a short section on token rotation hazards and sample configs for Go and gateways. Also include a CLI reproduce script for support.
Omar Khan (Helio): Test result: 12m under ramp with oldKeep=2s and jittered backoff, no 403/429. Looks good. Will slowly ramp traffic to production levels.
Ravi Desai: Eng note: no server-side revokes during window; logs show many overlapping auth checks before change. I will attach logs to CS-11021 and mark steps for docs.
Priya Khatri: Action items: Omar to continue ramp and confirm, Ravi to close CS-11021 after attaching logs and playbook update, CS to remove TEMP_PERKEY_RELAX once Helio confirms stability. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
